# Citeable

> Citeable is an open-source GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) toolkit that audits how AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews see a website, and generates fixes.

Citeable runs 20 weighted checks across AI crawler access, structure, content, trust and technical health, and generates llms.txt, Organization JSON-LD and robots.txt rules. A paid tier monitors AI share of voice over time.
